top_fix: LCP on both project detail pages remains above 4 s (note-structurer: 4157 ms, screenshot-to-primevue: 4707 ms), keeping their performance scores below 85: preload the hero/LCP element on each detail page with `<link rel="preload" fetchpriority="high">`, serve all images as WebP at display dimensions, and defer or code-split non-critical JS — this is the single change most likely to push the remaining two pages above 85.
